# h3_k8s_kubeconfig (Data Source)

Admin kubeconfig of a managed Kubernetes cluster, with the API endpoint and CA parsed out for the `kubernetes`/`helm` providers. The kubeconfig is sensitive and ends up in the state. Uses API-key (HMAC) access to h3k8s (`api.h3llo.cloud/api/k8s/v3`): the key must list the project; scope `k8s:read` is enough to read, changes and the kubeconfig (admin credentials) need `k8s:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "h3_k8s_kubeconfig" "main" {
  project_id = var.project_id
  cluster_id = var.cluster_id
}

provider "kubernetes" {
  host                   = data.h3_k8s_kubeconfig.main.endpoint
  cluster_ca_certificate = data.h3_k8s_kubeconfig.main.cluster_ca_certificate
  config_path            = local_sensitive_file.kubeconfig.filename
}

resource "local_sensitive_file" "kubeconfig" {
  content  = data.h3_k8s_kubeconfig.main.kubeconfig
  filename = "${path.module}/kubeconfig"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID); the provider default when omitted

### Read-Only

- `cluster_ca_certificate` (String) Cluster CA certificate (PEM)
- `endpoint` (String) Kubernetes API server URL
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) Kubeconfig (YAML)
